5fcw:
The modern business world is changing at breakneck speed. Ongoing digital and operational disruption present unique challenges – as well as opportunities. Society needs new leaders who are agile, entrepreneurial and, above all, able to innovate under the toughest of conditions.

Students will develop solid foundations in modern business with La Trobe's Bachelor of Business. They will prepare to thrive in a digitally disrupted world with this highly flexible degree and start building a dream career in business.

Students will explore multiple business disciplines in the first year and develop foundational knowledge and enterprise skills in areas such as management, organisational structures, data analytics and ethical business practices.

Students will choose from a wide range of majors, minors and optional second majors. They can also pair their major with complementary study from another discipline.

No matter how students specialise, they'll get hands-on experience and learn the latest digital skills while developing essential leadership, communication and critical-thinking skills.

Students will develop professional business skills as they work in diverse teams, present business strategies and use the software that's essential in modern business.

They'll graduate with the perfect blend of business fundamentals and technical expertise so they can change the business world.

Students will learn:

  • Digital literacy: Use a wide range of digital and data-processing tools to analyse business activity and become a more effective business professional.
  • Management and business structures: Understand how to communicate, collaborate and connect with business peers and stakeholders.
  • Economics: Discover how business and society connect. Understand economic principles and use them to create business solutions.
  • Sustainability: Learn about environmental, corporate and governance responsibility. Develop sustainable solutions that prioritise individual and societal wellbeing.
7uwc:
La Trobe's Bachelor of Cybersecurity offers students the opportunity to step into the rapidly evolving digital world of cybersecurity.

Students will build a highly specialised technical skillset as they learn about the history of hacking, build their coding expertise, and access industry-based projects and mentoring opportunities with major corporations.

Students will also have the opportunity to complement their industry-focused learning with a choice of advanced electives in IT, business, law, policy and strategic communication.

Students will learn

  • Cybersecurity fundamentals
  • Learn the basic principles and best practices of cybersecurity. Understand how it mitigates cyber vulnerabilities and protects confidential information.
  • Ethical hacking and defence
  • Gain evaluation techniques to assess the security of network configuration and apply these skills to defend against network-based threats.
  • Programming and cyber algorithms
  • Explore the widely used Python programming language and learn how algorithms are used to solve cybersecurity challenges.
  • Network engineering
  • Study the architecture of computer networks and the internet, and examine protocols and services used in the defence of online information.
  • Cyber governance and risk management
  • Learn the frameworks for cybersecurity governance and risk mitigation based on your emerging understanding of business strategy and risk appetite.
5fax:
The world is drawing closer together. As the speed and quality of digital technologies continues to evolve, the world needs more passionate professionals who can create meaningful solutions and connections.

Designed to help build a digital future, La Trobe's Bachelor of Information Technology equips students with skills across programming, networking, databases, systems analysis and design, and project management.

Along with building a strong set of core IT skills students can choose to major in one of several areas aligned to future industry growth including artificial intelligence, cloud analytics, cybersecurity, network engineering or information systems.

Students will broaden their knowledge and capabilities further through a wide range of electives. They will combine their core IT skills with business, social sciences, humanities, web engineering, computer technology, security and information systems analysis subjects. Plus, they could develop a software program of their own to present at the annual Engineering and IT Showcase to potential employers.

With industry-based projects and CISCO certification embedded in the course, students will receive professional mentoring opportunities as they build career ready skills. They'll also gain access to La Trobe's expert research centres, including the Centre for Technology Infusion and state-of-the-art Technology Innovation Lab for the Internet of Things – developed in collaboration with Microsoft and CISCO.
934s:
The Master of Cybersecurity is a postgraduate program designed to prepare students to protect and manage digital information systems in an increasingly complex and connected world. The program develops advanced knowledge and practical skills in cybersecurity principles, technologies, and governance, enabling graduates to respond effectively to emerging threats and safeguard critical infrastructure.

Students explore topics such as network and system security, ethical hacking, cryptography, digital forensics, risk management, and cyber law. The curriculum balances theoretical foundations with real‑world applications, including simulated security environments and industry projects that reflect contemporary cybersecurity challenges.

Learners also develop strategic and analytical capabilities required for assessing vulnerabilities, designing secure systems, and managing organizational security frameworks in alignment with international standards and regulations.

Graduates are equipped for a wide range of roles, including cybersecurity analyst, security consultant, network security engineer, forensic investigator, and information security manager, across both public and private sectors.
934t:
The Master of Education (MEd) Global leadership is a postgraduate program designed for education professionals who wish to deepen their knowledge, enhance their practice, and take on advanced roles in teaching, leadership, and educational research. The program encourages critical reflection, innovation, and evidence‑based approaches to addressing contemporary challenges in education.

Students explore educational theory, curriculum design, assessment, policy development, and research methodologies, while also having the opportunity to specialize in areas such as leadership, inclusive education, digital learning, or early childhood education (depending on the institution’s structure).

This program places strong emphasis on the application of theory to practice, equipping educators to lead learning communities, drive curriculum improvement, and contribute to education reform. Many courses include action research or professional projects that allow students to apply new knowledge directly within their own teaching or organizational contexts.

Graduates are prepared for advanced teaching roles, curriculum leadership positions, educational consultancy, and policy or administrative careers in schools, higher education, and other learning environments.

This specialization equips student with the skills to lead people and projects in today’s dynamic global workplaces. They will explore how individuals and teams behave in organizations, learn strategies for motivating and engaging staff, and understand how culture, communication, and leadership shape effective workplaces. Through practical activities and real‑world case studies, you’ll develop the ability to analyze organizational challenges and apply evidence‑based solutions.

938g:
The Master of Information Technology in Software Engineering at La Trobe University is a postgraduate program designed to prepare students for leadership and specialist roles in the rapidly evolving field of information and communication technologies. The program provides advanced technical, analytical, and problem‑solving skills, combining theoretical foundations with hands‑on experience in developing practical IT solutions.

Students study core areas such as software engineering, data management, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing, gaining in‑depth knowledge of how technology supports business transformation and innovation. The course also emphasizes professional communication, project management, and strategic thinking — key competencies for IT professionals in global industries.

Depending on their interests and career goals, students can choose specialized study areas or research pathways. Through industry projects and applied learning, learners gain experience in solving real‑world technology challenges using contemporary tools and methodologies.

Graduates of this program are well‑equipped for roles in software development, systems analysis, IT consulting, network and security management, and technology project leadership across a wide range of sectors.

Develop complex software using design patterns and learn about the realities of software development from industry experts. Explore the construction and workings of the data structures and algorithms. Produce and manage large- and small-scale systems, including front- and back-end development. Master software measurement and automated testing using the latest frameworks. Access La Trobe's Digital Innovation Hub, created in partnership with technology leaders Cisco and Optus to foster collaboration between students, researchers, business and industry.

934u:
The Master of Public Health at La Trobe University is a postgraduate program that develops advanced knowledge and skills to protect and improve the health of populations. It is ideal for professionals seeking to address public health issues through evidence‑based practice, research, and policy development.

The program explores key areas such as epidemiology, biostatistics, health policy, environmental health, global health, and health promotion, providing students with a strong foundation in both theoretical and applied aspects of public health. Learners gain the ability to critically evaluate and design programs that promote population health, prevent disease, and reduce health inequities across diverse communities.

Students benefit from La Trobe’s strong partnerships with health organizations, government agencies, and research institutions, allowing them to apply their learning through practical projects and real‑world case studies. The course also emphasizes ethical leadership, interdisciplinary collaboration, and strategic problem‑solving skills that are essential for modern public health professionals.

Graduates are well‑prepared for careers in public health policy, health promotion, epidemiology, health management, and international health, working across public, private, and non‑government sectors.
72ji:
Global Master of Business Administration will help the Students become the adaptable leader these businesses are looking for.

Be ready for any challenge as they develop their skills and knowledge underpinning agile leadership. Build expertise applicable in any business, including financial knowledge and how to harness digital disruption. And go beyond just understanding business strategies – explore how top management leaders develop plans.

Wherever Students career, they've designed this degree so they build the industry-ready skills to take their next step. Learn from the business experts in La Trobe Business School. Hear guest lectures from experienced industry members. Complete projects that prepare them for the workplace. And get the option to apply there knowledge in a real-world industry placement with one of our industry partners.

During their degree, Students will build vital business and management skills and knowledge. With coursework modelled on real-world business requirements, they will discover how leading organisations manage their workforce, including the strategic and operational challenges of international business – then learn the techniques to develop and implement their own strategies.

From the human skills of negotiation and communication to the strategic expertise to translate data into action – Students can build their ability to lead in business.

Students will learn:

  • Leadership

Understand how to lead, collaborate and connect with your peers.

  • Digital literacy

Learn how to use a wide range of digital tools to become a more efficient and effective business professional.

  • Sustainable management

Learn about environmental, corporate and governance responsibility, and develop sustainable solutions that prioritise individual and societal wellbeing.

  • Corporate strategy

Explore how to drive change and innovation in modern business through the development and delivery of corporate strategies.

  • Employee behaviour

Understand how to best manage the behavioural dynamics of individuals and groups to achieve their best performance.
